title: VIEWE displays and portrait touchscreen
summary: Select the correct 2.8-inch or 3.5-inch panel, use synchronized portrait controls and read the connection status bar.
body: Windows 0.1.77 packages the latest VIEWE firmware source updates. These changes do not update the Android APK.

Choose the physical panel

Select VIEWE UEDX24320028E-WB-A for the 2.8-inch 240×320 panel, or VIEWE UEDX32480035E-WB-A for the 3.5-inch 320×480 panel. The same PCB marking may appear on different panel sizes. Check the product variant and visible screen size. A wrong choice can leave the picture black even though backlight and touch work.

Configure and flash

  1. Select the board in Windows Configuration. The onboard LCD and CHSC6540 touch need no external display wiring.
  2. Set rotation, backlight brightness and touch enable in Display. Both variants use the R3 drawing with wire anchors aligned to the physical pads.
  3. Compile for the selected board and flash. The device web interface exposes only the board that firmware was built for. Windows keeps both board choices.
  4. Touch the screen to wake it. If the backlight works without a picture, check the exact panel variant before changing drivers or pins.

Portrait navigation and synchronized controls

The touchscreen dropdown follows the web tab order. Peripheral-dependent pages appear only when the matching hardware is configured. The LCD and web interface use shared settings and action handlers. Browser updates reach the LCD, and LCD changes refresh an open browser while preserving edits in progress. Text fields use Save changes; selections, switches and released sliders apply automatically. Leave a saved-password field blank to keep its value.

Read the status bar

Wi-Fi shows AP or STA mode, with four bars for station signal strength. S+A means both modes are active. MQTT is green when connected and has a red cross when disconnected. The clock displays device time when available. Playback, battery or storage indicators appear when applicable and when screen width permits. The bar remains above the scrolling page.

Small-screen views

Logics and wiring use compact lists and live controls; detailed editing stays in Windows or the browser. The development source adds SD folder navigation with parent/root controls, file playback, play/stop, previous/next, seek where available and volume. Audio adds Country and Station selectors and a top-bar speaker button with a volume popup. These controls share playback state with the web interface. Plots shows recent values; full file management, plot charts and importing another device remain browser workflows. The LCD interface is a simplified native interface, not a full web browser.

Validation

The 3.5-inch manufacturer example and ELMA picture were confirmed on the test device. The latest portrait build booted, reported a successful LVGL draw and preserved settings and Logics. Physical inspection of the updated layout remains pending. The separate 2.8-inch profile has software tests but still needs testing on a physical 2.8-inch panel.
